title: Gym Year Card vs Month Card (13‑month window)
description: Compare the total payment required to cover exactly 13 months of gym access using a yearly membership versus a monthly membership. Both plans grant identical gym access with no signup or per‑visit fees.
originalInput: Compare a gym year card costing USD 600 per 12 months with a month card costing USD 60 per month over exactly 13 months. Both plans provide the same gym access. Compare actual payments needed to cover that window, including a full renewal payment when needed. These are all prices; there are no signup fees or per-visit charges. Do not amortize the annual payment, assume a partial refund, or introduce workout frequency or time per visit.

tags.name: Upfront affordability
tags.description: Does paying the larger upfront amount for the year card fit your budget?

targets.consideration: If you prefer lower initial outlay, does the month card suit you better?
If you can handle a larger upfront cost, does the year card work for you?

tags.name: Usage consistency
tags.description: How steady is your gym attendance over the next year?

targets.consideration: If you expect to use the gym regularly, does the year card give you peace of mind?
If your attendance might vary, does the month card let you adjust more easily?

tags.name: Changing needs
tags.description: Might your fitness goals or schedule shift in the coming months?

targets.consideration: If you anticipate needing a break or switching facilities, does the year card lock you in?
If you want the freedom to stop or change plans quickly, does the month card suit you?

tags.name: Flexibility
tags.description: How important is the ability to pause or cancel without loss?

targets.consideration: If you value the option to suspend access temporarily, does the month card offer that?
If you are okay with a longer commitment for a lower effective rate, does the year card appeal?

tags.name: Access requirements
tags.description: Do you need guaranteed access for the full 13‑month window without gaps?

targets.consideration: If uninterrupted access matters, does buying two year cards (or one year + one month) meet that need?
If you prefer to renew monthly, does paying each month ensure continuous access?

tags.name: Renewal terms
tags.description: Are you comfortable with automatic renewal or prefer manual renewal each period?

targets.consideration: If you dislike frequent renewals, does the year card reduce renewal hassle?
If you want to review your gym use each month, does the month card give you that chance?
